CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ${database}
KEEP ${keepDays}

CREATE STABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${database}.${superTable} ( ts TIMESTAMP, event_ts BIGINT, point_id NCHAR(128), point_code NCHAR(128), point_name NCHAR(256), value_text NCHAR(1024), unit NCHAR(64), quality INT, success BOOL, message NCHAR(1024), raw_json NCHAR(2048), processed_json NCHAR(2048), metadata_json NCHAR(4096) ) TAGS ( device_id NCHAR(128), protocol_type NCHAR(64) )

CREATE STABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${database}.${superTable} ( ts TIMESTAMP, point_key VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, event_ts BIGINT, point_id NCHAR(128), point_code NCHAR(128), point_name NCHAR(256), value_text NCHAR(1024), unit NCHAR(64), quality INT, success BOOL, message NCHAR(1024), raw_json NCHAR(2048), processed_json NCHAR(2048), metadata_json NCHAR(4096) ) TAGS ( device_id NCHAR(128), protocol_type NCHAR(64) )
ALTER STABLE ${database}.${superTable} ADD COLUMN unit NCHAR(64)
